english.title: Buy controlled alcoholic products wholesale from UK person when wholesaler not approved
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) bought controlled alcoholic products wholesale, namely **(..SPECIFY THE TYPE OF ALCOHOLIC PRODUCTS..), from a person who was UK-established for the purposes of value added tax, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..), who was not an approved wholesaler in relation to that sale when you knew or had reasonable grounds to suspect that the UK person from whom the controlled alcoholic products were bought was not an approved wholesaler in relation to that sale
english.legislation: Contrary to section103(1)(a) and 104(4)(a)and (5) of the Finance (No. 2) Act 2023.
